question.problem: The formula for the $n$th term of an geometric sequence is ${a}_{n}=0.1\cdot {2}^{n}$ for $n\ge 1.$  What is the recursive formula for this sequence?
question.worked_solution:
The recursive formula for an geometric sequence is

$$
{a}_{n+1}=r\cdot {a}_{n}.
$$

To complete the formula, we must determine the common ratio $r$ and state the first term ${a}_{1}.$ The first two terms are

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{1} & =0.1\cdot {2}^{1}=0.2, \\ {a}_{2} & =0.1\cdot {2}^{2}=0.4.\end{aligned}
$$

Hence, the common ratio is

$$
\begin{aligned}r & =\frac{{a}_{2}}{{a}_{1}}=\frac{0.4}{0.2}=2.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the recursive formula for the geometric  sequence is

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n+1} & =2{a}_{n},\,{a}_{1}=0.2,\,n\ge 1.\end{aligned}
$$
